factor_name: Beta-adjusted short reversal blended with contrarian 20-day trend

calculation.description: Estimate each asset's 60-day beta to the equal-weighted tradable-universe return. Reverse its causal five-day beta-adjusted residual return, volatility normalize it, and blend with a slower contrarian 20-day return signal. CS denotes cross-sectional median centering and scaling by median absolute magnitude. Higher values predict higher five-day forward returns. All inputs are lagged through the prior completed day.

validation.regime_notes: Positive five-day IC in 2020-24 (0.037666), 2025-27 (0.039288), and 2028-29 (0.032022), but materially weaker in 2030-09-03 (0.002728). Ten-day predictive power remains positive overall but fails the admission horizon gate; monitor recent drift conservatively.
